criterion.hard_delivery: Selected image: both judges explicitly pass all four critical checks and independently measured canvas passes.
criterion.usable_delivery: Hard delivery and mean of eight craft dimension scores >= 4.0.
criterion.false_accept: Selected but not a two-judge hard pass; clear failure, disagreement, and unverified are distinguished.
criterion.false_hold: An explicitly reported hold although at least one preserved candidate meets the usable criterion; failed/missing delivery is counted separately.
criterion.null_policy: A null check is unverified, never an inferred pass or explicit failure. A hold or failed/missing delivery has no selected craft. Completed failed attempts remain in the task denominator; every generated original is scored, even without a project copy or report. Missing telemetry stays null and has a separate observed-session denominator.
criterion.ratio_rule: abs(width * ratio_denominator - height * ratio_numerator) <= max(ratio_numerator, ratio_denominator); at most one integer pixel rounding in either dimension.
criterion.cost_limit: Reported orchestrator cost may omit image pricing; it is not a complete image cost.
criterion.scope: Three paired exploratory briefs, no significance or general advantage claims.

correction_retention.scope: All second image_gen calls in nine prospective final-payload sessions; no samples replaced.

method.exact_prefix: The entire actual first image_gen prompt must be an unchanged character prefix of the second; no normalization.
method.raw_original_verbatim: Whether the complete original user brief string appears in the actual tool prompt; includes operational/rights/output metadata deliberately removed from drawing prompts, so false does not by itself imply a lost visual condition.
method.semantic: Manual comparison of actual first/second drawing prompts and parameters to the original subject, count, visibility, framing, material/light, exclusions, canvas. Broad subject-only exclusions are not counted as transmitting explicit no-text/logo/watermark restrictions.
method.canvas: Actual aspect_ratio parameter checked against unchanged original requested ratio.
method.attribution: Original omissions already present in the first prompt are separated from newly omitted correction conditions. Prompt transmission is distinct from image compliance or quality.

limits: One correction per matching session, small exploratory sample.
All baseline sessions used one image call, so final-matrix baseline correction retention has denominator zero.
No new correction omission observed in any arm; plain pebbles inherited omission of explicit no-words/logos/watermarks from its first prompt.
Retained prompt conditions do not prove the generated image complies.
Reported orchestration cost may omit image billing.

development.scope: Historical development inputs, separate from fresh generation. Each row retains its own candidate and pool denominators.
development.decision: Reject visual-review candidates A, B and C. Retain only original-condition preservation in 2.1.5.

targeted_correction.scope: One paired development correction using candidate A, one image_gen call per arm; separate from the final retained 2.1.5 payload and fresh-generation comparison.
targeted_correction.blinding: Two fresh reviewers saw anonymous paths and original conditions only. First exploratory review excluded because directory names exposed arms.
targeted_correction.criterion: Both reviewers pass every original hard check and measured ratio; mean eight craft ratings >=4.0.

limits: Three briefs, one session per arm and brief; no general aesthetic or statistical superiority claim.
Two fresh Codex model reviewer contexts, not human preference; exact reviewer model identifiers were not verified.
Baseline final-generation runs made no corrections: no baseline retention estimate from that matrix.
Current pebble correction changed a candidate both reviewers already considered usable, without a craft gain.
Original visual conditions were retained, but literal raw-user-brief reuse was not achieved; opening wording was compressed and operational fields removed.
Reported orchestration cost may omit image charges.
Historical count and occlusion self-review failures remain unresolved.
Fresh-image selection accuracy decreased from 10/12 to 9/12, with false rejects increasing from two to three. The broader no-regression criterion failed.
Baseline strict procedural failure and current auxiliary crop/receipt format defects prevent describing the comparison as entirely protocol-clean.
The fresh transfer set has no occlusion-negative image or all-ineligible pool; historical occlusion failures remain unresolved.

verification.snapshot: Git-listed working files; seven runtime and metadata files match the live pin, verified snapshot and final tree. README and CHANGELOG edits followed the pin and receive separate documentation checks.

transfer.scope: All 12 freshly generated images; one isolated zero-generation session per arm with identical original briefs, anonymous inputs, pools, model, effort, 30-turn and 900-second limits.
transfer.scoring: Any hard-eligible pool selection counts as correct; eligibility labels are separate from craft. Both runs had complete reports and intact inputs, so visual scores remain available despite the separately recorded baseline procedural failure.
notes: Both arms rejected the four-pebble and embossed-carafe negative controls. There was no new occlusion-negative image or all-ineligible pool.
Current false rejects treated background paper in two pebble images and the integrated lamp base in one image as extra objects. The no-eligibility-regression criterion failed.

Baseline wrote nine plain-text diagnostic receipts despite a JSON-only restriction, failing the strict procedural gate. Scoreability was separated from this temporary-receipt-format defect before the baseline result returned; current had already completed.

Current wrote 29 temporary JPEG crops with .png names and inaccurately described them as PNG re-encodings. PNG was permitted, not mandatory; this is an auxiliary format/receipt defect, not a source change or independent procedural failure.

The scorer initially rejected both configurations because native CLI startup appended the same five marketplace bootstrap lines. The preserved intermediate null result was superseded only after allowing that exact suffix; isolation changes still fail.

A harness import created one bytecode cache in the external current pin after the current run. It was moved to diagnostic evidence and the pin was rechecked. Executed isolated payloads were unchanged.
Seventeen provider-free scorer boundary checks passed. No provider reruns, image calls, input edits, label edits or answer edits were made.
Reported orchestration cost may omit image billing. Seconds are per-session elapsed time.

adoption.retained_component: Complete first drawing prompt plus targeted correction, explicit original-condition checks before the call, and rechecking all critical conditions afterward.
adoption.basis: The preregistered useful-component fallback is applied only to correction-condition preservation; the targeted development correction and two final correction prompts support this narrow behavior.
